content.short: DEXLab AI provides secure, AI-driven blockchain analytics for DeFi trading.
content.description: DEXLab AI provides token analytics to help users assess risk and understand tokenomics, supporting informed decisions and scam avoidance. Its token analysis flags suspicious transfer limits and dynamic tax adjustments, while a holder analysis reveals dominant wallets and liquidity influencers for deeper insight into token stability. A live audit initiated at token launch delivers immediate visibility into contract integrity and tokenomics, and live lock detection alerts traders when liquidity is securely locked, fostering trust in new token projects and reducing uncertainty.
